about: Chord progressions to try (docs/design.md, section 14; src/model/chords/Progressions.h). Each chord is a Roman numeral in the key the progression is written for: upper case for a chord with a major third, lower case for one with a minor third, then its kind (7, maj7, m7b5, sus4, 9...), and /1 to /3 for an inversion; a b or # before it lowers or raises its root. A chord lasts a bar unless *2, *0.5 and so on say otherwise.

progressions.name: Pop anthem
progressions.feel: Bright and hopeful: the four chords of countless hits.

progressions.name: Wistful pop
progressions.feel: The same four chords starting on the minor one: longing, then lifting.

progressions.name: Doo-wop
progressions.feel: Sweet and retro, the sound of the 1950s.

progressions.name: Lifting pop
progressions.feel: Warm and open, rising at the end of each turn.

progressions.name: Away from home
progressions.feel: Starts away from home and never quite settles.

progressions.name: Climb to the minor
progressions.feel: Climbs and lands on the minor chord instead of home: a build with a twist.

progressions.name: Three-chord rock
progressions.feel: The three chords of rock, blues and country.

progressions.name: Country back and forth

progressions.name: Rock steady
progressions.feel: Laid back, rocking between the three main chords.

progressions.name: Mixolydian rock
progressions.feel: Bluesy and bold, with a lowered seventh chord.

progressions.name: Big rock
progressions.feel: Huge and anthemic, with chords borrowed from the minor.

progressions.name: Gritty rock
progressions.feel: Rough around the edges: a borrowed chord that bites.

progressions.name: Heroic
progressions.feel: Triumphant: the sound of a level cleared.

progressions.name: 12-bar blues

progressions.name: Royal road

progressions.name: Canon

progressions.name: Bittersweet turn
progressions.feel: A bright start that turns sad.

progressions.name: Minor sigh

progressions.name: Gospel turn

progressions.name: Rising line

progressions.name: Lydian lift
progressions.feel: Floating and open, a little magical.

progressions.name: The ii-V-I
progressions.feel: The cadence of jazz: smooth and resolved.

progressions.name: Turnaround
progressions.feel: Round and round, with sevenths.

progressions.name: Two dreamy chords
progressions.feel: Two soft major sevenths, back and forth.

progressions.name: Stepping down
progressions.feel: Sevenths stepping down to home.

progressions.name: Lo-fi ninths
progressions.feel: Rich, hazy ninth chords.

progressions.name: Soul cycle

progressions.name: Epic minor

progressions.name: Driving minor
progressions.feel: Restless and pushing forward.

progressions.name: Dark minor
progressions.feel: Moody and heavy, all minor chords.

progressions.name: Two dark chords

progressions.name: Minor sway
progressions.feel: Swaying between two minor chords.

progressions.name: Andalusian cadence
progressions.feel: Dramatic and passionate, stepping down to a major chord.

progressions.name: Phrygian menace
progressions.feel: Tense and threatening: the chord a semitone up.

progressions.name: Minor cadence
progressions.feel: Classical and dramatic, with a major five chord pulling home.

progressions.name: Rise to minor

progressions.name: Minor ii-V-i

progressions.name: Dorian groove
progressions.feel: Cool and funky: a minor chord with a major four.

progressions.name: Power chords
